contracts.source: Recursion press release: Recursion Announces Sanofi Options Potential First-in-Class (10-15-2026)
contracts.signal: Sanofi has optioned the first development candidate from the two companies' multi-program research collaboration: a potential first-in-class (company claim) oral small molecule against a challenging dual target implicated in inflammatory disease, designed with Recursion's AI-enabled drug design platform and small-molecule chemistry. The candidate has been added to Sanofi's development pipeline and is expected to enter phase 1 clinical trials in 2027, with Sanofi funding and leading further development and commercialization. The option triggered a $10 million milestone payment, to be recognized as revenue in the third quarter of 2026, bringing total upfront and milestone payments received from Sanofi under the collaboration to $144 million; Recursion is eligible for more than $300 million in additional milestones under the program, with an average of low double-digit royalties on net product sales if successfully commercialized. The payment ends Recursion's operational requirements for this candidate. The collaboration has now achieved six progress-based milestones across five programs, and other programs have the potential to reach development candidate and other progress-based milestones over the next 12 months. CEO Najat Khan: the milestone is 'another important demonstration of how our platform can translate computational capabilities into differentiated medicines'.
contracts.units: first development candidate optioned; six progress-based milestones across five programs
